newsitem.title: USA: Childtime Learning enters Washington market.
newsitem.headline: Childtime Learning enters Washington market.

text.p: Childtime Learning Centers Inc said Monday it has entered the Washington market for the first time with the purchase of nine facilities from Abundant Life Childcare Centers in Seattle.
The company also has been awarded a federal contract to operate the Abundant Life Childcare Solutions center in downtown Seattle. No financial terms were disclosed.
Childtime said it is the fifth largest provider of child care and preschool services in the U.S. It now has 228 centers, serving 22,000 children and parents in 16 states and the District of Columbia.
"Going forward, we have the resources -- along with a highly transportable format -- to intensify this initial entry into the Pacific Northwest," Chief Executive Harold Lewis said in a statement.
